component.name: Sprite Sheet Helper
component.summary: Create game-ready sprite sheets from animated 3D models

description.p: Sprite Sheet Helper turns animated GLB, GLTF, FBX, and OBJ models into sprite sheets, GIFs, normal maps, and engine-ready export packages.
Frame animations with reusable camera workflows, refine materials and effects, capture or edit poses, and export deterministic atlases for popular game engines.
